spec_match.rationale: Threads the spec's ManifestId identity through the real lifecycle exactly as the explainer defines it: add() returns it, list() resolves record<ManifestId,{appName}> keyed by it, remove() consumes it and returns {removedApps, failedApps} with NotFoundError for foreign parents.

interactive.rationale: list() and remove() buttons call the real methods when bound, a checkbox inventory enables removal per ManifestId, and live results update the table — with a clearly-captioned illustrative inventory keeping the round trip demonstrable when the binding is absent.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises following the identity from add() through list() keys into remove() with real method calls; the page delivers the flow diagram, the real calls, and the identity-as-join-column explanation.

edge_cases.rationale: Handles absent binding (labelled sample, explicit no-platform-call messaging on remove), list()/remove() rejections with real exception names, partial removals via failedApps, and empty-inventory hiding.

references.rationale: See-also cites https://chromestatus.com/feature/6260680824061952, the explainer's identity section, and the official sample demo.

conformance.rationale: The suite's list/remove typeof and list-resolves-record assertions encode this page's contract; failures in this plain-origin Chromium 141 are the expected absent IWA-only binding.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CLI/CDP (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): initial DOM renders the flow diagram, disabled remove button, and honest instructions; zero console errors, no unintended failed requests; the list/select/remove interactions could not be driven non-interactively.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts live/unsupported/rejected branches for both list() and remove(), including illustrative removals, with counts and exception names.

design_system.rationale: Tokenised colours throughout; the amber note is border-only, secondary buttons override background and color together, and no sub-AA text pairing is reachable (accent-blue arrows are decorative and aria-hidden).

accessibility.rationale: Checkboxes get visually-hidden labels naming each app plus clickable id/name label associations, the result is an aria-live output, the decorative flow diagram is aria-hidden, the remove button is disabled until a selection exists, and captions distinguish live vs illustrative data.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP-emulated 360×740 DPR3 measures 0px horizontal overflow (result pane uses overflow-wrap:anywhere, flow chips wrap); desktop 1280×800 clean; only the environmental Google Fonts request fails; checkboxes are enlarged to 1.5rem for touch.

openQuestions.title: Run the full add() → list() → remove() identity loop inside a real IWA
openQuestions.detail: Only the absent-binding branch is reachable on this origin, so the live record<ManifestId,{appName}> shape, a real removal via removedApps, and the NotFoundError foreign-parent case remain unobserved. Following the linked subapps-demo setup on a flagged ChromeOS build, install two sub apps, list them, remove one by its ManifestId, and record the resolved shapes — which also unblocks the suite's positive list-resolves-record branch.

summary: A well-designed lifecycle page that makes the ManifestId join-column tangible: real list()/remove() wiring, honest labelled fallback inventory, careful accessibility on the selection table, and precise identity semantics from the explainer. Verified with headless Chromium 141 via CLI/CDP (chrome-devtools-mcp unavailable in this environment): clean render and console, no unintended failed requests, no overflow on either device class. The only open item is capturing the real in-IWA identity round trip.
